title: JayAnvil
description: Tired of plain item names? My plugin lets you personalize your gear a bit more by adding `&` as well as HEX color support when you rename stuff in anvils.
body:
# JayAnvil
Tired of plain item names? My plugin lets you personalize your gear a bit more by adding color support when you rename stuff in anvils. Use the classic `&` codes or splash in some cool hex colors like `&#FFAA00` to make your items really stand out. It’s simple, lightweight, and works perfectly on Spigot/Paper/Purpur/Bukkit 1.21.10 — no complicated setup or configuration, just more QoL for your server.
